attempts.summary: Built a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, mariadb-server 10.11 + galera-4), created an appdb database with a customers table and appuser credentials, and confirmed multi-master replication among the three. Then added node4 as a fourth member: configured Galera to join the existing cluster, started mariadb which triggered an SST copying all existing data, and verified node4 accepts writes that replicate to the other three. Finally performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full Galera quorum/data recovery after each restart.
